title: SocioVerse: A World Model for Social Simulation Powered by LLM Agents and A Pool of 10 Million Real-World Users

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating US presidential election voting behavior using LLM agents conditioned on comprehensive demographic and ideological profiles, and comparing the simulated state-level electoral outcomes against real-world election results using Accuracy and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE).

Assessing simulated public attitudes toward breaking news (e.g., the release of ChatGPT) through a multi-dimensional ABC attitude model questionnaire, and comparing the response distributions of LLM agents against ground-truth social media users using KL-Divergence and Normalized RMSE.

Simulating a national economic survey by sampling agents based on regional income distributions, and measuring the consistency of their generated monthly spending allocations across various categories (e.g., housing, food) against official national statistics using Normalized RMSE and KL-Divergence.
